system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Custom prompt files support variable expansion. All variables use the `{{VARIABLE}}` syntax.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Claude explores your codebase, asks clarifying questions
env_context_strategy.note: ralphex passes a prompt to Claude Code/codex, which navigates the repo itself.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Each task executes in a fresh Claude Code session with minimal context, keeping the model sharp throughout the entire plan.
context_compaction.note: Context management by fresh sessions per task, not by history rewriting inside ralphex.

observation_format.evidence_quote: reads stdout as a stream of JSON events
observation_format.note: ralphex consumes text events from the executor; no images.

tool_call_format.note: ralphex itself has no tool-call protocol; it shells out to claude/codex CLIs. Inner agent signals are emitted as text markers like <<<RALPHEX:COMPLETED>>>.

tool_count.evidence_quote: ralphex prompts instruct the agent to emit signals like `<<<RALPHEX:COMPLETED>>>` or `<<<RALPHEX:FAILED>>>` in its output.
tool_count.note: No tool schemas are defined by ralphex; tools belong to the underlying Claude Code/codex CLI.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: The prompt is passed via stdin (not as a CLI argument).
edit_primitive.note: Editing is done by the delegated coding CLI, not by ralphex primitives.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Place custom prompt files in `~/.config/ralphex/prompts/` to override the built-in prompts.
tool_schema_source.note: Only hand-written prompt/agent text files; no schema generation.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: The overrides layer on top of the user's `~/.codex/config.toml` rather than replacing it, so user customizations (model, sandbox, MCP servers) are preserved.
protocol_standardization.note: MCP only mentioned as a user setting of the underlying codex CLI; ralphex itself speaks no protocol.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: ralphex executes plans in four phases with automated code reviews, plus an optional finalize step.
loop_primitives.note: Default is the fixed four-phase pipeline over a plan file; validation commands run after each task and fixes iterate (generate_test_repair); task_retry_count=1 gives multi_attempt.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Reads plan file and finds first incomplete task (`### Task N:` with `- [ ]` checkboxes)
planning_granularity.note: Markdown plan file with checkbox state is read and updated across steps.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Launches 5 review agents **in parallel** via Claude Code Task tool
multi_agent_topology.note: ralphex orchestrates executor sessions and review subagents.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Each `{{agent:name}}` expands to Task tool instructions that tell Claude Code to run that agent.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: When reviewing the draft, you can accept, revise with text feedback, open it in `$EDITOR` for interactive annotation, or reject it.
human_in_loop.note: Also Ctrl+\ pause to steer mid-run; action-level approval is disabled (--dangerously-skip-permissions).

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Plan file tracks task state (`[ ]` vs `[x]`).
short_term_state.note: Plan checkboxes plus progress file constitute the run state; each session is fresh.

long_term_memory.note: Progress/plan files persist across sessions and runs and are referenced in prompts via {{PROGRESS_FILE}}.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: To resume, re-run `ralphex docs/plans/<plan>.md`. Ralphex detects completed tasks via `[x]` checkboxes in the plan and continues from the first incomplete task.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Runs validation commands (tests, linters) after each task
self_verification.note: Multi-agent review phases (self_critique/llm_judge) plus external codex review as independent judge.

rollback.evidence_quote: The default `finalize.txt` prompt rebases commits onto the default branch and optionally squashes related commits into logical groups.
rollback.note: Commits after each task on a dedicated branch; worktrees removed on success. No explicit undo/reset command in harness.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: The loop terminates when: all issues resolved, max iterations reached, stalemate detected (via `--review-patience`), or manual break via Ctrl+\ (SIGQUIT).
termination_condition.note: model_declared via <<<RALPHEX:ALL_TASKS_DONE>>> signal; review-patience stall detection off by default (0).

cost_controls.evidence_quote: use different models for tasks and reviews
cost_controls.note: Per-phase/per-agent model selection (plan/task/review model, agent frontmatter model). No token budget or caching in ralphex; rate-limit wait+retry instead.

timeouts.note: Both session_timeout and idle_timeout disabled by default; codex_timeout_ms 3600000 is set by default for the external codex call.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: ralphex is a standalone CLI tool that runs in your terminal from the root of a git repository.
execution_isolation.note: Optional Docker wrapper (ralphex-dk.sh) gives container isolation; also --worktree isolation.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: ralphex runs Claude Code with `--dangerously-skip-permissions`, giving it full access to execute commands and modify files.
filesystem_access.note: In Docker mode scoped to the mounted /workspace.

network_policy.evidence_quote: **Network:** Full network access (required for Claude API calls)

permission_model.note: Permissions are skipped by default so every action executes; external codex review runs read-only sandbox.

tracing.evidence_quote: Progress file (`.ralphex/progress/progress-*.txt`) is a real-time execution log—tail it to monitor.
tracing.note: Timestamped/phase-tagged progress logs plus SSE web dashboard; no OTel.

replayability.evidence_quote: Reviews re-run from iteration 1, but fixes from previous iterations remain in the codebase.
replayability.note: Progress logs are not replayable; only plan-state resume exists.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: ralphex is a standalone CLI tool that runs in your terminal from the root of a git repository.
eval_hooks.note: Repo ships e2e/ Go tests of itself but no benchmark evaluation runner.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Security warning emitted for sensitive names (KEY, SECRET, TOKEN, etc.) with explicit values - use name-only form for secure credential passing
guardrails.note: Error/limit pattern matching on executor output halts runs; validation commands gate task completion; Docker mounts restrict access.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Autonomous plan execution with Claude Code and codex

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: The `claude_command` and `claude_args` config options let you replace Claude Code with any CLI that produces compatible `stream-json` output.
model_agnostic.note: Agent-CLI agnostic rather than direct LLM API; also Bedrock/codex/Gemini/Copilot paths.
